title: Apollo 17 - On the Shoulders of Giants
description: A documentary view of the Apollo 17 journey to Taurus-Littrow, the final lunar landing mission in the Apollo program, is discussed. The film depicts the highlights of the mission and relates the Apollo program to Skylab, the Apollo-Soyuz linkup, and the Space Shuttle.
